description.narrative: Access to higher quality of post-trade services: Transparent and efficient post-trade services which provide timely access to data are essential for the functioning and development of the capital market. By working with Vortx, which uses technology, AI to enable automation, faster execution, transparency, and real-time compliance for issuers of fixed income securities, fund managers and investors, IFC anticipates helping investors, asset managers, and issuers gain access to significant quality improvements in post-trade services. Increase competitiveness: By fostering the growth of a leading innovator among independent fiduciaries and custodians for fund administration and corporate trustee services, IFC anticipates that the Project will demonstrate the scaling potential of technology-driven fiduciary and post-trade services, contributing to the consolidation of independent providers and the digital transformation of processes and workflow in post-trade.

The project consists of an equity investment for a minority stake in Vértera Holding S.A. (Vertera, Vortx, or the Company), a leading regulated, independent cloud-based fiduciary, trust, and fund administration agent for the local capital markets in Brazil. IFC is proposing US$20 million in preferred equity financing to support the Companys operations and organic and inorganic expansion.
